t: Cordless pruner provides excellent cutting performance for quick and easy pruning of small branches, cutting up garden waste, and DIY wood projects. Features PM3 saw chain with 1/4" pitch and protective hood. An LED indicator on the side of the tool shows the current battery charge. Soft-grip handles for ease of use. Supplied in a carry case that can be mounted to a wall. Supplied with AS 2 battery for up to 25 minutes working time, providing around 80 cuts in 4cm branches. This product requires chain oil (not included).
b: 2 Year Manufacturer’s Warranty Domestic Use (Proof of purchase required, T&Cs apply)
